title: The console concept page lists links between concepts, with the editor's words
description: Found in PPY-bcb81f. components/reference-links-client.ts and lib/reference-links.ts keep only rows whose subject is a Reference, so concept.link rows (an editor's related_to link between two concepts, with a note, written by createConceptLink) are invisible on /newsroom/concepts/<key>. Show them with the explanation block and the 'through the CLI' byline, and let an editor edit the words. UX: screenshot review before release.
